_comment: Project-level MCP server registration. Each developer enables it in their own .claude/settings.local.json via 'enabledMcpjsonServers': ['aistock-validation']. Paths are repo-relative so multi-worktree setups all resolve correctly. The python interpreter must have the mcp + httpx packages available; on this project that means activating the AIstock conda env (or any venv with `pip install mcp httpx`).
